title: Mastering Atari, Go, Chess and Shogi by Planning with a Learned Model (MuZero)
description: Learns a model of the environment's dynamics without access to game rules. MuZero combines model learning + MCTS. Surpasses AlphaZero while working in unknown environments.
authors: Schrittwieser, Antonoglou, Hubert, Lanctot, Sifre, Schmitt, et al.
